content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint with the Central Authority regarding a defective product. After a preliminary inquiry, the Central Authority finds that the matter is related to a sector regulated by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI).
content.outcome: The Central Authority refers the matter to TRAI along with its report, as per Section 19(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What happens when a complaint is filed with the Central Authority?
